# laravelforge_server_php_opcache (Data Source)

Fetches the PHP OPcache status of a Laravel Forge server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server.

### Read-Only

- `opcache_enabled` (Boolean) Whether PHP OPcache is enabled on the server.
